Definition: from G5288; shrinkage (timidity), i.e. (by implication) apostasy:--draw back.
BiblicalUsage: hypostolḗ means shrinking back, timidity. In Hebrews 10:39, the text says "But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hypostolḗ, I take at face value: shrinking back, timidity.
